prompts.player: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite sheet for an original painted forest platform RPG. Create exactly EIGHT isolated full-body poses of the SAME charming original chibi woodland apprentice caster, arranged precisely in a 4-column by 2-row evenly spaced grid, reading left to right. Each grid cell has generous transparent margin, no pose or wand crosses into another cell, no labels or text. Character: oversized expressive 3/4 face looking RIGHT, warm peach skin, glossy dark chestnut bob hair, enormous friendly hazel eyes, tiny nose, rosy cheeks, teal pointed leaf-brim wizard hat with small apricot blossom and gold leaf pin; layered emerald capelet, cream blouse, deep teal petal tunic with gold embroidered leaf borders, brown ankle boots and little satchel; slender wooden wand tipped with a glowing amber bud. Two-heads-high chibi proportions; deeply charming boutique hand-painted storybook 2D game art, rich layered brushwork, rounded dimensional shapes, soft warm sunlight edge highlights, crisp deep teal outer contour, warm shadows, detailed but clean at 80 pixels tall. Not pixel art, not flat polygon vector art, not 3D render. Identical costume and identity in all eight. Pose order row1: 1 relaxed ready idle smiling wand angled up; 2 WALK left leg forward contact right leg behind, cape swings backward, wand tucked; 3 WALK opposite right leg forward left behind, clear split leg silhouette arms counter swing; 4 JUMP airborne tucked knees bent, hat trailing cape billows, excited. Row2: 5 WAND ATTACK lunging right, arm stretched strongly forward and wand pointing right, planted feet far apart; 6 MAGIC anticipation gathering light, wand raised overhead both hands spread cape swirls; 7 HURT recoiling left head back eyes squeezed, wand lowered, off-balance bent knees; 8 FALL descending arms out wide, feet lowered apart, worried face. Every pose completely contained, clear foot baseline within each cell, visible face, all limbs and wand intact. Transparent background with actual alpha, no ground shadows, no environment, no frame, no watermark. All completely original, no recognizable existing characters.

prompts.creature: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite sheet for original painted forest platform RPG. Exactly FOUR full-body isolated poses of the SAME little mossbud creature opponent arranged in ONE horizontal row of four equal cells, plentiful transparent padding. Faces look RIGHT in three-quarter view. A round pear-shaped mint-green woodland seed critter with a thick curling fern tail, two tiny dark teal paws, expressive enormous shiny dark eyes and rosy cheeks, crown of two rounded emerald leaves and one little apricot bud, scalloped moss cheek tufts, subtle gold freckles, pale buttery belly. Original charming mischievous opponent, clear unusual silhouette, soft painterly dimension and beautifully textured leaves with warm lit edges, crisp deep forest teal contour. Match premium hand-painted children's storybook forest RPG art, detailed painted texture but readable at 60 pixels tall. No pixel art, no polygon vector art, no 3D. Pose1: ready idle upright pear silhouette, happy sly eyes, tail curling up. Pose2: ATTACK TELL deep squashed crouch, eyes narrowed, cheeks puffed, leaves pressed back, tail arched high, silhouette much wider and shorter, paws braced. Pose3: ATTACK springing diagonally RIGHT, elongated body stretched horizontally, open mouth spirited shout, front paws reaching, leaves trailing back, tail straight extended left; very clearly different horizontal silhouette. Pose4: HURT recoil tilted left, crumpled leaves, eyes tightly scrunched, mouth surprised, both paws lifted and tail curled inward. Preserve character identity, colors, anatomy across all four poses. Entire bodies and tails contained within their cells with margin, no overlapping, no shadows, no ground, no scenery, no lettering, no watermark. Genuine transparent alpha background.

prompts.playerPassingCorrection: Precise sprite sheet edit. Keep all eight cells unchanged except TOP ROW SECOND CELL walking character. Redraw ONLY her LEGS and BOOTS into the passing step pose: BOTH KNEES CLOSE TOGETHER directly under skirt, one straight leg with boot planted directly under body and the other knee lifted forward with its boot tucked back near the standing calf. Narrow leg silhouette, NOT the wide running split, NOT two boots far apart. Keep her face hat arms wand cape identical to input. All other seven characters must stay exactly same. Genuine transparent background.

normalization: draw_cast.py crops each isolated cel from actual generated alpha, discards alpha<128 background haze, preserves painted RGBA edges, downsamples with Lanczos, and packs against unchanged runtime foot pivots.
limitations: Eight authored player key poses and four creature poses; not a full inbetween animation set.
